content: {"reasoning":"The CO-197 denial concerns missing required authorization; retroactive authorization and peer-to-peer review are unavailable under this payer's rules. Eligibility, coding, and COB are correct, so resubmitting without resolving the denial would not address its cause. A formal medical-necessity appeal is available because a denial is on the table and is the next valid route to pursue payer payment without shifting the full balance to the patient.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
